review_description: Lakes Solar was good and provided a quote for the equipment I wanted ( REC panels, Sunlock hardware, Fronius of SMA inverter) but were more expensive for the same gear from GEA.East Gippsland solar rang me back but when I specified the equipment I wanted I never heard from them again.I decided to go with a local contractor from Bairnsdale,  GEA, they supply the equipment I specified and do their own installation and have done a good job.
